evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Foundation models promise accurate forecasts with little or no task-specific training, but whether they can replace models designed specifically for electricity price forecasting remains unclear.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Their performance is assessed in terms of point and probabilistic forecasting accuracy, as well as economic value in battery energy storage arbitrage.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We compare nine variants from five foundation model families, evaluated in zero-shot mode, with two state-of-the-art electricity price forecasting benchmarks in Germany, Poland, and Spain over 2021-2025.
